records.subject: A better way to track team projects
records.body:
Hi Nora,

A reminder that your Wrenfield workspace is ready whenever you are -- creating one real project is the easiest way to see what it's for.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Clearwater Group!
records.body:
Hi Nora,

Welcome to Wrenfield. If you're bringing a team along, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and seats can be added any time from Account Settings.

I'm around if you need anything.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: Project created day 0 and 1 invite sent shows early intent, but no key_milestone in 6 days and zero replies to three Wrenfield emails (email:7bb13a58, email:f92d4b8b, email:e6871336). No tickets, so no signal of active troubleshooting. 8 days left on a Pro plan gives some chance of self-serve activation.

draft.subject: A hand with your first Clearwater Group project
draft.body:
Hi Nora,

You've got a project up and a teammate invited already — nice start. Projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so the next step is usually getting a bit of real work into that project alongside your colleague.

If it's helpful, I'm happy to jump on a short call this week and walk through that with you — or just reply here and I'll answer by email.

Best,
Chidi
